param(
    [string]$RestResponse,
    [string]$PreRenewalCaptureStatus,
    [string]$PreRenewalCaptureJobId,
    [string]$PreRenewalCaptureCachePath,
    [string]$PreRenewalWorkflowInstanceIdUsed,
    [string]$PreRenewalCorrelationIdUsed,
    [string]$PreRenewalPreviousSerialNumber,
    [string]$PreRenewalPreviousSha1Thumbprint,
    [string]$PreRenewalPreviousSha256Thumbprint,
    [string]$PreRenewalCapturedAtUtc
)

function Normalize-WorkflowValue {
    param(
        $Value,
        [string]$DefaultValue = "-"
    )

    if ($null -eq $Value) {
        return $DefaultValue
    }

    $stringValue = [string]$Value

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($stringValue)) {
        return $DefaultValue
    }

    $cleanValue = $stringValue.Trim()
    $cleanValue = $cleanValue.Trim([char]34).Trim([char]39).Trim()

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($cleanValue)) {
        return $DefaultValue
    }

    return $cleanValue
}

function First-Value {
    param($Value)

    if ($null -eq $Value) {
        return "-"
    }

    return [string]$Value
}

function Get-MetadataValue {
    param(
        $Metadata,
        [string]$Name,
        [string]$DefaultValue = "-"
    )

    if ($null -eq $Metadata) {
        return $DefaultValue
    }

    $property = $Metadata.PSObject.Properties[$Name]

    if ($null -eq $property) {
        return $DefaultValue
    }

    return Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $property.Value -DefaultValue $DefaultValue
}

function Get-FirstUsableValue {
    param(
        $Values,
        [string]$DefaultValue = "-"
    )

    foreach ($value in $Values) {
        $normalized = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $value -DefaultValue ""

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($normalized)) {
            return $normalized
        }
    }

    return $DefaultValue
}

function Format-CertificateDateForEmail {
    param(
        [string]$Value
    )

    $normalized = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $Value -DefaultValue "-"

    if ($normalized -eq "-") {
        return "-"
    }

    $formatted = $normalized
    $formatted = $formatted -replace "T", " "
    $formatted = $formatted -replace "Z", ""
    $formatted = $formatted -replace "\+00:00", ""

    if ($formatted.Length -ge 19) {
        return $formatted.Substring(0, 19)
    }

    return $formatted
}

function Get-DaysRemaining {
    param(
        [string]$NotAfterValue
    )

    $normalized = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $NotAfterValue -DefaultValue "-"

    if ($normalized -eq "-") {
        return "-"
    }

    try {
        $cleanDate = Format-CertificateDateForEmail -Value $normalized

        if ($cleanDate -eq "-") {
            return "-"
        }

        $notAfterDate = Get-Date $cleanDate
        $nowDate = Get-Date
        $remaining = New-TimeSpan $nowDate $notAfterDate

        if ($remaining.Days -lt 0) {
            return "0"
        }

        return [string]$remaining.Days
    }
    catch {
        return "-"
    }
}

function Get-NotExpiredResult {
    param(
        [string]$NotAfterValue
    )

    $normalized = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $NotAfterValue -DefaultValue "-"

    if ($normalized -eq "-") {
        return "-"
    }

    try {
        $cleanDate = Format-CertificateDateForEmail -Value $normalized

        if ($cleanDate -eq "-") {
            return "-"
        }

        $notAfterDate = Get-Date $cleanDate
        $nowDate = Get-Date

        if ($notAfterDate -gt $nowDate) {
            return "PASS"
        }

        return "FAIL"
    }
    catch {
        return "-"
    }
}

function Normalize-ValidationPerspective {
    param(
        [string]$Value
    )

    $normalized = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $Value -DefaultValue "-"

    if ($normalized -eq "Internal orchestrator perspective") {
        return "Internal Keyfactor Universal Orchestrator perspective"
    }

    return $normalized
}

function New-FailureResult {
    param(
        [string]$Message
    )

    return @{
        "EmailOutcomeHeadline" = "Application TLS Certificate Renewal Validation Requires Review"
        "EmailOutcomeStatus" = "FAIL"
        "EmailActionRequired" = "Review required"
        "EmailOutcomeSummary" = "Unable to prepare certificate renewal assurance email data. " + $Message
        "EmailRecommendedAction" = "Review workflow and validation metadata before confirming renewal status."

        "EmailApplicationName" = "-"
        "EmailApplicationOwner" = "-"
        "EmailApplicationOwnerEmail" = "-"
        "EmailWebsiteName" = "-"
        "EmailWebsiteUrl" = "-"
        "EmailWebsitePort" = "-"
        "EmailServerName" = "-"
        "EmailPlatform" = "-"
        "EmailEnvironment" = "-"

        "EmailApplicationUrlTested" = "-"
        "EmailValidatedAtUtc" = "-"
        "EmailCertificateValidUntilUtc" = "-"
        "EmailCertificateDaysRemaining" = "-"
        "EmailCertificateNotExpired" = "-"

        "EmailPreviousCertificateSerialNumber" = "-"
        "EmailRenewedCertificateSerialNumber" = "-"
        "EmailPreviousCertificateSha1Thumbprint" = "-"
        "EmailRenewedCertificateSha1Thumbprint" = "-"
        "EmailPreviousCertificateSha256Thumbprint" = "-"
        "EmailRenewedCertificateSha256Thumbprint" = "-"
        "EmailPreviousCertificateCapturedAtUtc" = "-"
        "EmailRenewedCertificateValidatedAtUtc" = "-"
        "EmailCertificateChanged" = "-"
        "EmailCertificateChangeSummary" = "-"
        "EmailPreRenewalCaptureStatus" = "-"

        "EmailEndpointServingRenewedCertificate" = "-"
        "EmailCommandInventoryMatch" = "-"
        "EmailHttpResponse" = "-"
        "EmailTlsHandshake" = "-"
        "EmailHostnameSanMatch" = "-"
        "EmailCertificateChainValidation" = "-"
        "EmailEndpointReachable" = "-"
        "EmailServedCertificateCaptured" = "-"
        "EmailIssuerCaptured" = "-"
        "EmailHttpHealth" = "-"
        "EmailResponseTimeMs" = "-"
        "EmailTestedFrom" = "-"

        "EmailScopeEndpointTested" = "-"
        "EmailScopeProtocol" = "-"
        "EmailScopePort" = "-"
        "EmailScopeSniUsed" = "-"
        "EmailScopePathTested" = "-"
        "EmailScopeClientPerspective" = "-"

        "EmailWorkflowInstanceId" = "-"
        "EmailWorkflowDefinitionId" = "-"
        "EmailValidationJobCorrelationId" = "-"
        "EmailValidationProfile" = "-"
        "EmailAssuranceModelVersion" = "-"
        "EmailExpectedCertificateId" = "-"
        "EmailExpectedStoreId" = "-"
        "EmailTestedFromOrchestrator" = "-"

        "EmailCertificateStoreId" = "-"
        "EmailCertificateId" = "-"
        "EmailCertStoreInventoryItemId" = "-"
        "EmailLastServedSerial" = "-"
        "EmailLastServedSha1" = "-"
        "EmailLastServedSha256" = "-"
        "EmailLastServedSubject" = "-"
        "EmailLastServedIssuer" = "-"
        "EmailLastServedSan" = "-"
        "EmailLastServedNotBeforeUtc" = "-"
    }
}

try {
    $inventory = $RestResponse | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ($null -eq $inventory) {
        throw "REST response was empty or could not be parsed."
    }

    $storeEntry = @($inventory)[0]

    if ($null -eq $storeEntry) {
        throw "REST response did not contain a certificate store inventory entry."
    }

    $certificate = @($storeEntry.Certificates | Where-Object { $_.CertState -eq 1 })[0]

    if ($null -eq $certificate) {
        $certificate = @($storeEntry.Certificates)[0]
    }

    if ($null -eq $certificate) {
        throw "REST response did not contain a certificate object."
    }

    $metadata = $certificate.Metadata

    $certificateValidUntilRaw = Get-FirstUsableValue -Values @(
        (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_LastServedNotAfterUtc" ""),
        $certificate.NotAfter,
        $certificate.ExpirationDate,
        $certificate.ValidUntil
    )

    $certificateValidUntil = Format-CertificateDateForEmail -Value $certificateValidUntilRaw
    $certificateDaysRemaining = Get-DaysRemaining -NotAfterValue $certificateValidUntilRaw
    $certificateNotExpired = Get-NotExpiredResult -NotAfterValue $certificateValidUntilRaw

    $servedCaptured = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_CheckServedCertCaptured" "-"
    $inventoryMatch = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_CommandInventoryMatch" (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_CheckInventoryMatch" "-")
    $lastStatus = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_LastStatus" "-"

    $endpointServingRenewedCertificate = "-"

    if (($lastStatus -eq "PASS") -and ($inventoryMatch -eq "PASS")) {
        $endpointServingRenewedCertificate = "PASS"
    }
    elseif (($servedCaptured -eq "PASS") -and ($inventoryMatch -eq "PASS")) {
        $endpointServingRenewedCertificate = "PASS"
    }

    $validatedAtRaw = Get-FirstUsableValue -Values @(
        (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_LastValidatedUtc" ""),
        (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_CustomJobCompletedAtUtc" ""),
        (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_EvidenceGeneratedAtUtc" "")
    )

    $validationPerspective = Normalize-ValidationPerspective -Value (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ClientPerspective" "-")

    $previousSerial = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $PreRenewalPreviousSerialNumber
    $previousSha1 = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $PreRenewalPreviousSha1Thumbprint
    $previousSha256 = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $PreRenewalPreviousSha256Thumbprint
    $previousCapturedAt = Format-CertificateDateForEmail -Value $PreRenewalCapturedAtUtc
    $preRenewalStatus = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $PreRenewalCaptureStatus

    $renewedSerial = Get-FirstUsableValue -Values @(
        (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_RenewedCertificateSerialNumber" ""),
        $certificate.SerialNumber,
        (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_LastServedSerial" "")
    )

    $renewedSha1 = Get-FirstUsableValue -Values @(
        (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_RenewedCertificateSha1Thumbprint" ""),
        $certificate.Thumbprint,
        (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_LastServedSha1" "")
    )

    $renewedSha256 = Get-FirstUsableValue -Values @(
        (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_RenewedCertificateSha256Thumbprint" ""),
        (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_LastServedSha256" "")
    )

    $renewedValidatedAt = Format-CertificateDateForEmail -Value $validatedAtRaw

    $certificateChanged = "-"
    $certificateChangeSummary = "Pre-renewal evidence was not available for before/after comparison."

    $hasPreviousEvidence = (($previousSerial -ne "-") -or ($previousSha1 -ne "-") -or ($previousSha256 -ne "-"))
    $hasRenewedEvidence = (($renewedSerial -ne "-") -or ($renewedSha1 -ne "-") -or ($renewedSha256 -ne "-"))

    if ($hasPreviousEvidence -and $hasRenewedEvidence) {
        $serialChanged = (($previousSerial -ne "-") -and ($renewedSerial -ne "-") -and ($previousSerial -ne $renewedSerial))
        $sha1Changed = (($previousSha1 -ne "-") -and ($renewedSha1 -ne "-") -and ($previousSha1 -ne $renewedSha1))
        $sha256Changed = (($previousSha256 -ne "-") -and ($renewedSha256 -ne "-") -and ($previousSha256 -ne $renewedSha256))

        if ($serialChanged -or $sha1Changed -or $sha256Changed) {
            $certificateChanged = "PASS"
            $certificateChangeSummary = "The endpoint certificate changed from the pre-renewal certificate to the renewed certificate validated after renewal."
        }
        else {
            $certificateChanged = "FAIL"
            $certificateChangeSummary = "The pre-renewal and renewed endpoint certificate identifiers matched; review renewal and deployment behavior."
        }
    }

    $result = @{
        "EmailOutcomeHeadline" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_OutcomeHeadline" "Application TLS Certificate Renewal Verified - No Action Required"
        "EmailOutcomeStatus" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_OutcomeStatus" (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_LastStatus" "-")
        "EmailActionRequired" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ActionRequired" "None"
        "EmailOutcomeSummary" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_OutcomeSummary" "The renewed TLS certificate is deployed and being served by the application endpoint. The live served certificate was captured, validated, and matched to Keyfactor Command inventory."
        "EmailRecommendedAction" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_RecommendedAction" "No application-owner action is required."

        "EmailApplicationName" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ApplicationName" "-"
        "EmailApplicationOwner" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ApplicationOwner" "-"
        "EmailApplicationOwnerEmail" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ApplicationOwnerEmail" "-"
        "EmailWebsiteName" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_WebsiteName" "-"
        "EmailWebsiteUrl" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_WebsiteUrl" "-"
        "EmailWebsitePort" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_WebsitePort" "-"
        "EmailServerName" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_Server" "-"
        "EmailPlatform" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_Platform" "-"
        "EmailEnvironment" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_Environment" "-"

        "EmailApplicationUrlTested" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_AppUrlTested" (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_WebsiteUrl" "-")
        "EmailValidatedAtUtc" = Format-CertificateDateForEmail -Value $validatedAtRaw
        "EmailCertificateValidUntilUtc" = $certificateValidUntil
        "EmailCertificateDaysRemaining" = $certificateDaysRemaining
        "EmailCertificateNotExpired" = $certificateNotExpired

        "EmailPreviousCertificateSerialNumber" = $previousSerial
        "EmailRenewedCertificateSerialNumber" = $renewedSerial
        "EmailPreviousCertificateSha1Thumbprint" = $previousSha1
        "EmailRenewedCertificateSha1Thumbprint" = $renewedSha1
        "EmailPreviousCertificateSha256Thumbprint" = $previousSha256
        "EmailRenewedCertificateSha256Thumbprint" = $renewedSha256
        "EmailPreviousCertificateCapturedAtUtc" = $previousCapturedAt
        "EmailRenewedCertificateValidatedAtUtc" = $renewedValidatedAt
        "EmailCertificateChanged" = $certificateChanged
        "EmailCertificateChangeSummary" = $certificateChangeSummary
        "EmailPreRenewalCaptureStatus" = $preRenewalStatus

        "EmailEndpointServingRenewedCertificate" = $endpointServingRenewedCertificate
        "EmailCommandInventoryMatch" = $inventoryMatch
        "EmailHttpResponse" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_HttpResponse" "-"
        "EmailTlsHandshake" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_TlsHandshake" "-"
        "EmailHostnameSanMatch" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_HostnameSanMatch" "-"
        "EmailCertificateChainValidation" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_CertChainValidation" "-"
        "EmailEndpointReachable" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_CheckEndpointReachable" "-"
        "EmailServedCertificateCaptured" = $servedCaptured
        "EmailIssuerCaptured" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_CheckIssuerCaptured" "-"
        "EmailHttpHealth" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_CheckHttpHealth" "-"
        "EmailResponseTimeMs" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ResponseTimeMs" "-"
        "EmailTestedFrom" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_TestedFrom" "-"

        "EmailScopeEndpointTested" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_EndpointTested" "-"
        "EmailScopeProtocol" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ScopeProtocol" "-"
        "EmailScopePort" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ScopePort" "-"
        "EmailScopeSniUsed" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_SniUsed" "-"
        "EmailScopePathTested" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_PathTested" "-"
        "EmailScopeClientPerspective" = $validationPerspective

        "EmailWorkflowInstanceId" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_WorkflowInstanceId" "-"
        "EmailWorkflowDefinitionId" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_WorkflowDefinitionId" "-"
        "EmailValidationJobCorrelationId" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ValidationJobCorrelationId" "-"
        "EmailValidationProfile" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ValidationProfile" (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_AssuranceModelVersion" "-")
        "EmailAssuranceModelVersion" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_AssuranceModelVersion" "-"
        "EmailExpectedCertificateId" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ExpectedCertificateId" "-"
        "EmailExpectedStoreId" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_ExpectedStoreId" "-"
        "EmailTestedFromOrchestrator" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_TestedFromOrchestrator" "-"

        "EmailCertificateStoreId" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_CertificateStoreId" "-"
        "EmailCertificateId" = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value (First-Value $certificate.Id)
        "EmailCertStoreInventoryItemId" = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value (First-Value $certificate.CertStoreInventoryItemId)
        "EmailLastServedSerial" = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $certificate.SerialNumber
        "EmailLastServedSha1" = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $certificate.Thumbprint
        "EmailLastServedSha256" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_LastServedSha256" "-"
        "EmailLastServedSubject" = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $certificate.IssuedDN
        "EmailLastServedIssuer" = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $certificate.IssuerDN
        "EmailLastServedSan" = Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_LastServedSan" "-"
        "EmailLastServedNotBeforeUtc" = Format-CertificateDateForEmail -Value (Get-MetadataValue $metadata "KFValidation_LastServedNotBeforeUtc" "-")
    }
}
catch {
    $result = New-FailureResult -Message $_.Exception.Message
}

return $result

param(
    [string]$ValidationProfileName,
    [string]$ValidationCommandServer,
    [string]$ValidationCertificateStoreId,
    [string]$ValidationRestInventoryUrl,
    [string]$ValidationProfilePlatform,
    [string]$ValidationProfileEnvironment,
    [string]$ValidationProfileServerName,
    [string]$ValidationProfileApplicationName,
    [string]$ValidationProfileWebsiteName,
    [string]$ValidationProfileWebsiteUrl,
    [string]$ValidationProfileWebsitePort
)

function Normalize-WorkflowValue {
    param(
        $Value,
        [string]$DefaultValue = "-"
    )

    if ($null -eq $Value) {
        return $DefaultValue
    }

    $StringValue = [string]$Value

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($StringValue)) {
        return $DefaultValue
    }

    $CleanValue = $StringValue.Trim().Trim([char]34).Trim([char]39).Trim()

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($CleanValue)) {
        return $DefaultValue
    }

    if ($CleanValue -like '$(*') {
        return $DefaultValue
    }

    return $CleanValue
}

$profile = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $ValidationProfileName -DefaultValue "nginx-web-server-tls"
$commandServer = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $ValidationCommandServer
$certificateStoreId = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $ValidationCertificateStoreId
$restInventoryUrl = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $ValidationRestInventoryUrl
$platform = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $ValidationProfilePlatform
$environment = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $ValidationProfileEnvironment
$serverName = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $ValidationProfileServerName
$applicationName = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $ValidationProfileApplicationName
$websiteName = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $ValidationProfileWebsiteName
$websiteUrl = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $ValidationProfileWebsiteUrl
$websitePort = Normalize-WorkflowValue -Value $ValidationProfileWebsitePort

if ($commandServer -eq "-") {
    throw "ValidationCommandServer was not available from the pre-renewal profile step."
}

if ($certificateStoreId -eq "-") {
    throw "ValidationCertificateStoreId was not available from the pre-renewal profile step."
}

if ($restInventoryUrl -eq "-") {
    $restInventoryUrl = "https://" + $commandServer + "/KeyfactorAPI/CertificateStores/" + $certificateStoreId + "/Inventory?PageReturned=1&ReturnLimit=10"
}

$result = @{
    "ValidationProfileName" = $profile
    "ValidationCommandServer" = $commandServer
    "ValidationCertificateStoreId" = $certificateStoreId
    "ValidationRestInventoryUrl" = $restInventoryUrl
    "ValidationProfilePlatform" = $platform
    "ValidationProfileEnvironment" = $environment
    "ValidationProfileServerName" = $serverName
    "ValidationProfileApplicationName" = $applicationName
    "ValidationProfileWebsiteName" = $websiteName
    "ValidationProfileWebsiteUrl" = $websiteUrl
    "ValidationProfileWebsitePort" = $websitePort
}

return $result
